failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is not higher than prior 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL continuing to decline week over week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next two weeks even though WORKPLACES continues its upward trajectory.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC growth rate over next four weeks is not greater than the growth rate predicted by either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT alone when both series are co-improving.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days rises meaningfully (by more than 3 points) above the last 28 day mean, contradicting the plateau/inertia assumption.
